issue.title: Diagnose the swallowed-exception raiser behind the two test_vcs_tag_* xprompt-selector flake nodes
issue.description: Proposed by sase-h8's land phase (bead sase-h8.10.4, epic sase-h8) while closing out the parallel-suite flake class. tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_bar_xprompt_selector_requests.py::test_vcs_tag_offers_project_local_xprompts_by_canonical_name and ::test_vcs_tag_directory_key_spelling_also_resolves were triaged by sase-h8.3 as family F1 (off-pump settle gap) and handed to sase-h8.4 to fix. sase-h8.4 falsified that assignment: on_prompt_input_bar_snippet_requested is fully synchronous (no pilot, no message pump, no worker/thread/to_thread anywhere in the project-local lookup), so there is no off-pump boundary to inject a delay at. The real mechanism is a swallowed exception -- the lookup block in src/sase/ace/tui/actions/_prompt_bar_requests.py ended in 'except Exception: pass', so any raise (leading candidate: a stale sase_core_rs binding surfacing through resolve_project_config_read_path -> resolve_project_layout, the same root cause the sase-h8.3 triage table records for the F4 node test_malformed_header_block_leaves_authored_metadata_visible) is indistinguishable from 'this project has no xprompts'. This matches the durable health store exactly: all 3 recorded occurrences failed as a pair, and one run (20260807T010908Z-e3bfbbcbfe21) has these two as its ONLY two failures. sase-h8.4 landed instrumentation rather than a bogus wait: the swallow now does log.exception(), and both tests assert via caplog that nothing was swallowed, so a recurrence will fail loudly naming the traceback instead of silently mismatching. It verified the guard by injecting 'raise OSError' into the lookup (both tests then fail together, reproducing the store's exact pairing signature), but the actual production raiser has not recurred since the instrumentation landed, so the underlying defect is still unfixed. Residual work: watch for the caplog assertion to fire under real load (dev host or CI), capture the traceback it now surfaces, and fix the raiser at its mechanism.
